name: Madrid Transit Pack
author: xoaninc
description: Standardized Madrid train types, one per real network: Metro narrow-profile (CAF S/3000, lines 1-5), Metro wide-profile (S/8000-9000, lines 6-12), Metro Ligero (Citadis 302) and Cercanías Madrid (S/452 Alstom X'Trapolis). Real-world specs from official technical documentation: 90 m minimum curve radius and 5% max gradient per the Metro de Madrid track standards, real platform lengths (60-115 m), narrow-profile tunnels are cheaper to bore, and 140 km/h high-capacity commuter EMUs with 100/200 m consists. One type per network (instead of per-model) means branches and shared tracks between lines of the same network are fully compatible. Cercanías stats derived from DanielD1909's danTrains (MIT), verified against the real S/452 specs. Full sources in the README.
